<subject>FW: 2024 Strategy Presentation Rehearsal</subject>
<body>
Alex:  
Please let me know if you plan to attend the entire review session or just the 2:30 - 3:30 PM slot. You mentioned earlier that Liam should participate. Is there anyone else from your team who should join? Please advise. Thanks.

-----Original Message-----  
From:  Murphy, Emma  
Sent:  Thursday, April 18, 2024 11:07 AM  
To:  O’Connor, Alex; Byrne, Seán; Walsh, Fiona; Kelly, Niamh; Nolan, Cian; Doyle, Aidan  
Cc:  Fitzgerald, Maeve; Brennan, Conor; Hayes, Ciara; Ryan, Liam; Walsh, Orla; O’Brien, Kate; Murphy, Emma; Daly, Ronan; O’Brien, Kate  
Subject: 2024 Strategy Presentation Rehearsal  

The leadership team would like to conduct a run-through of the presentation for the upcoming Strategy reviews scheduled for May 1. Please see the attached agenda for your team’s allotted time. We will be meeting in Conference Room 3B at the Dublin office.  

If you need to join remotely, please use the call-in details below.  
If you cannot attend, please arrange for a delegate to participate on your behalf.  

CALL IN:  
PARTICIPANT CODE:  543210  
* Toll Free Dial-In Number:  1800 555 1234  

If you are dialing in, please send your presentation slides to me in advance so I can prepare copies.  

Feel free to invite any other colleagues who should attend. If you have questions, I can be reached at +353 1 234 5678.  

Thanks,  
Emma  
</body>
